players.product: Glass wafers for supporting semiconductors (WSG carrier glass) and glass substrates for probe cards; inorganic core substrates (GC Core glass-ceramic core and glass core substrate) under joint development with semiconductor companies

quarterly_data.quarter: Nippon Electric Glass semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (08-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 (January-June 2026) semi-annual report: net sales JPY 156,406 million (up 1.7%), operating profit JPY 11,373 million (down 31.8%), ordinary profit JPY 16,290 million (up 14.7%, helped by foreign exchange gains on revaluing receivables and payables tied to overseas subsidiaries' borrowings) and profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 6,414 million (down 36.4%), after the business restructuring expense for halting production at and transferring the U.S. composites subsidiary (announced July 6, 2026) was booked as an extraordinary loss. Management states electronic device sales were flat year on year as strong sales centred on data-center-related products offset lower sales of semiconductor products, display sales rose on continued steady demand, and operating profit fell on higher display-business costs for conversion to all-electric melting facilities and periodic repairs and for starting up medical-business glass production equipment at the Malaysian subsidiary.
